messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Drill 4 round through-passages of 4 mm diameter through the flat middle section of the rod, in a single straight line at 25 mm, 40 mm, 55 mm, and 70 mm along the length, perpendicular to the wide flat faces.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response:
```json
{
  "match": true,
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "reason": "The edited part clearly shows four circular holes drilled in a straight line through the middle section, consistent with the instruction to drill 4 round through-passages."
}
```
